title: Gift Options
content: Build gift options section for checkout. Toggle: "This is a gift" checkbox to reveal options. Gift wrapping: selection of wrapping styles with images and prices, or free option. Gift message: textarea for personal message (max 150 chars with counter). Gift receipt: checkbox to include gift receipt (price hidden). Preview: show wrapped product mockup if available. Recipient info: optional separate shipping address for gift.

variants.simple: Create gift options form with message and wrapping selection.
variants.detailed: Build gift options section for checkout. Toggle: "This is a gift" checkbox to reveal options. Gift wrapping: selection of wrapping styles with images and prices, or free option. Gift message: textarea for personal message (max 150 chars with counter). Gift receipt: checkbox to include gift receipt (price hidden). Preview: show wrapped product mockup if available. Recipient info: optional separate shipping address for gift.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive gift options section for cart/checkout flow. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 border. Gift toggle: checkbox or switch "This order is a gift" with Gift icon, unchecked hides all options, checking reveals animated expansion (max-height transition). Gift wrapping section: "Select Gift Wrap" label, grid of wrapping options (3-4 options) as selectable cards. Each card: image of wrapping style (w-full aspect-square), name ("Classic Red", "Birthday Celebration"), price ("+ $4.99" or "Free"), selected state (ring-2 ring-black). None option: "No Gift Wrap - Free" default selected. Premium options: higher tier wrapping with better presentation at higher price. Gift bag alternative: for items that don't wrap well. Gift box: rigid box option for premium feel. Gift message: "Add a Gift Message" expandable section or always visible. Textarea: max-length 150-200 chars, character counter (text-gray-500 text-sm), placeholder "Enter your message here...", preview of how message will appear on card. Message card style selector: if multiple card designs available, small thumbnails to choose. Handwritten option: premium option for hand-written message at extra cost. Gift receipt: checkbox "Include gift receipt" with info tooltip explaining receipt shows items but not prices. From/To fields: optional fields for card printing "From: [name]" "To: [name]". Preview section: if assets available, show rendered preview of wrapped package with message card, or placeholder illustration. Separate shipping: "Ship to different address" checkbox revealing secondary address form for gift recipient, gift message sent with package, order confirmation (with prices) sent to buyer. Hide prices: "Hide prices on packing slip" checkbox. Scheduling: for gift delivery, date picker "Deliver on specific date" for timed gift arrival. Per-item gifts: in cart, option to mark individual items as gifts with different wrapping/messages. Corporate gifting: bulk gift options, CSV upload for multiple recipients. Summary: in order summary, show "Gift wrap: Classic Red - $4.99", "Gift message: included". Accessibility: expandable sections properly announced, form fields labeled.
